classification.difficultyReason: Construct a cumulative-frequency distribution and graph, then use the polygon to identify the median integer score.

inlines.text: Draw the frequency and cumulative frequency table.
Tally each score in ascending order. Add each frequency to the preceding cumulative total.
Draw the cumulative frequency histogram and polygon.

answer.short: Cumulative bar heights: $3,8,10,13,15$ for scores $11,12,13,14,15$, respectively.
answer.worked: Use unit-width bars centred on the integer scores, with heights $3,8,10,13,15$. Begin the polygon at zero on the first bar’s left boundary and join the upper-right corners of successive bars.

spec.description: Cumulative histogram with integer score labels at bar centres and a blue polygon through the upper-right corners.

inlines.text: Use the cumulative frequency polygon to find the median.

answer.worked: There are $15$ scores, so read across from $\mathrm{cf}=\frac{15}{2}=7.5$ to the polygon and down to the horizontal axis. The intersection lies within the bar labelled $12$. Since the scores are integers, the median is $12$.
